id: 06_Other General Hazards Lab Safety Video Part 6
title: 实验室的其他常见危害（国内版）
source_doc: course/Chemical Spillage & Response/06_Other General Hazards Lab Safety Video Part 6.md
author_source: project/Chemical Spillage & Response/06_Other General Hazards Lab Safety Video Part 6（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 还有几类危害同样重要
points.K4: 通电时不维修、不开外壳
points.K5: 常查电线，用合格插线板
points.K10: 滑倒、绊倒、跌落可以避免
points.K19: 遵守规程，大小事故都能减少
points.S2: 有人触电：先断电再施救
points.S3: 高温高压设备：归零再开、有人值守
points.S6: 小事故、未遂事件也要报告

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室通道中央，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in the middle of a clear lab aisle and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看看实验室里的其他危害。
overlay: 实验室的其他常见危害

shots.scene: 电插头、火焰、雪花、滑倒小人、气瓶五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: an electric plug with a lightning bolt, a hot surface, a snowflake, a slipping person pictogram and a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 触电、烫伤、冻伤、摔跤和气瓶。

shots.scene: 阿杰拎着两桶纯水进门，顺手放在过道地上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries two water jugs into the lab and sets them down on the floor in the aisle.
shots.narration: 阿杰把两桶水随手放在过道上。

shots.scene: 小研抱着一摞空白文件走来，差点被绊倒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks in carrying a stack of blank folders and nearly trips over the jugs.
shots.narration: 小研差点被绊倒。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这些不起眼的危害，同样不能小看。

shots.section_title: 还有几类危害同样重要
shots.scene: 前几课的图标依次闪过：实验服、洗眼器、试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Icons flash by one after another: a lab coat, an eyewash station, a reagent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 前面学了着装、设施、行为和化学品。
overlay: 还有几类危害同样重要

shots.scene: 仪器背后电线带闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with a power cord and a small lightning bolt icon above it, with an electric shock warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 很多仪器在很高的电压下工作。

shots.scene: 仪器旁的水杯被红叉，移开后打勾
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of water next to an instrument power cord crossed out with a red X; then the beaker moved far away with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 水和液体，要远离仪器和电线。

shots.section_title: 通电时不维修、不开外壳
shots.scene: 插着电打开仪器外壳的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a screwdriver opening an instrument cover while the plug is still in the socket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通着电，不要维修，也不要打开外壳。
overlay: 通电时不维修、不开外壳

shots.section_title: 通电时不维修、不开外壳
shots.scene: 老李先拔掉插头，再打开仪器外壳
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unplugs an instrument first, then opens its cover with a screwdriver.
shots.narration: 维修交给专业人员，先断电。

shots.section_title: 常查电线，用合格插线板
shots.scene: 阿杰检查电源线，发现一段外皮破损
shots.prompt_en: The young male student inspects a power cord and finds a frayed section with exposed insulation.
shots.narration: 定期检查，电线破损要停用报修。
overlay: 常查电线，用合格插线板

shots.section_title: 常查电线，用合格插线板
shots.scene: 合格的插线板打勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean certified power strip with a few plugs neatly inserted, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 只用合格的延长线和插线板。

shots.scene: 插线板串着插线板、缠成一团，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: A power strip plugged into another power strip with a tangled mess of cords, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板不串接，电线不缠成一团。

shots.scene: 大功率设备接在墙上专用插座
shots.prompt_en: A large drying oven plugged directly into its own dedicated wall socket. No people.
shots.narration: 大功率设备用专用插座。

shots.scene: 王老师指着配电箱
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a closed electrical distribution box on the wall.
shots.narration: 不私拉乱接，电路改动找专业电工。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 有人触电的示意：电线搭在人形图标上
shots.prompt_en: A simple pictogram of a person touching an instrument with a lightning bolt between them. No people.
shots.narration: 有人触电，先切断电源。
overlay: 有人触电：先断电再施救

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 徒手拉人的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand pulling a person who is being shocked, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万不能徒手去拉。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 电话和红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后呼救，拨打120并报告。

shots.scene: 高压灭菌器冒着热气
shots.prompt_en: A closed autoclave with heat waves rising from its lid, with a hot surface warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 灭菌器等设备温度很高，会烫伤人。

shots.scene: 小研戴厚耐热手套取出灭菌后的物品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing thick heat-resistant gloves lifts a wire basket out of an opened autoclave.
shots.narration: 取热的东西，一定戴耐热手套。

shots.scene: 仪器面板上温度读数下降
shots.prompt_en: An instrument control screen showing a thermometer icon with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 加热仪器先把温度降下来，

shots.scene: 阿杰等温度降低后再打开仪器盖
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waits beside an analytical instrument, then opens its oven cover after the thermometer icon turns blue.
shots.narration: 再打开盖子。

shots.section_title: 高温高压设备：归零再开、有人值守
shots.scene: 灭菌器压力表指针归零
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of an autoclave pressure gauge with the needle back at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 高压设备，压力归零、降温后才开盖。
overlay: 高温高压设备：归零再开、有人值守

shots.section_title: 高温高压设备：归零再开、有人值守
shots.scene: 无人看管的加热板被红叉
shots.prompt_en: A hot plate turned on in an empty lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加热设备不能无人值守。

shots.section_title: 高温高压设备：归零再开、有人值守
shots.scene: 烘箱里放易燃溶剂瓶的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flammable solvent bottle placed inside a drying oven, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 烘箱里不能放易燃物。

shots.scene: 干冰盒冒白雾，超低温冰箱
shots.prompt_en: A box of dry ice with white fog next to an ultra-low temperature freezer with frost on the door. No people.
shots.narration: 极低温，同样会伤皮肤。

shots.scene: 小研戴上长款低温手套，从超低温冰箱取样品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on long insulated cryogenic gloves and takes a sample rack from an ultra-low freezer.
shots.narration: 拿干冰和超低温冰箱里的东西，戴隔热手套。

shots.scene: 小房间里液氮罐冒白气，人形图标头晕
shots.prompt_en: A small closed room with a liquid nitrogen dewar releasing white vapor and a dizzy person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 液氮、干冰挥发，会挤走空气里的氧气。

shots.scene: 通风良好的房间打勾
shots.prompt_en: A well-ventilated room with an open vent and airflow arrows, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 只在通风良好的地方使用。

shots.scene: 干冰装进拧紧的密封瓶被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of dry ice being sealed inside a tightly capped bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 干冰不能装进密封容器。

shots.section_title: 滑倒、绊倒、跌落可以避免
shots.scene: 滑倒小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a person slipping on a wet floor. No people.
shots.narration: 滑倒、绊倒、摔倒，伤害可能很重。
overlay: 滑倒、绊倒、跌落可以避免

shots.section_title: 滑倒、绊倒、跌落可以避免
shots.scene: 欣欣点头竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 但大多数，都能提前避免。

shots.scene: 阿杰把过道上的水桶搬到墙边架子上，椅子推进台下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves the water jugs from the aisle onto a low wall shelf and pushes a chair under the bench.
shots.narration: 地面和通道，保持畅通。

shots.scene: 地上放着箱子和仪器的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a box and an instrument placed on the lab floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 东西不放地上，临时放一下也不行。

shots.scene: 小研擦干地上的水，放上小心地滑提示牌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student mops up water from the floor and sets a yellow wet floor caution sign beside it.
shots.narration: 洒了马上擦，放好小心地滑提示牌。

shots.scene: 阿杰从低架下起身，差点碰头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands up from under a low shelf and almost bumps his head on its edge.
shots.narration: 留意周围，小心架子和台面碰头。

shots.scene: 气瓶图标内部压力箭头向外
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder icon with strong pressure arrows pushing outward from inside. No people.
shots.narration: 压缩气瓶里，压力非常高。

shots.scene: 倒下的气瓶瓶阀断裂，气瓶像火箭冲出的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple illustration of a fallen cylinder with a broken valve shooting forward like a rocket with motion lines. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦损坏，可能像炮弹一样飞出。

shots.scene: 带火焰象形图的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder with a GHS flame hazard pictogram on its shoulder. No people.
shots.narration: 有的气体，比如氢气，还极易燃。

shots.scene: 老李用绑带和夹具把气瓶固定在墙边
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer secures an upright gas cylinder to a wall bracket with a strong strap and clamp.
shots.narration: 气瓶要用夹具和绑带固定牢。

shots.scene: 手把保护帽拧到瓶头上
shots.prompt_en: A hand screws a protective cap onto the top of a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 不用的时候，拧上保护帽。

shots.scene: 几只不同颜色的气瓶，旁边有日历和对勾
shots.prompt_en: Several gas cylinders of different body colors standing in a rack, a calendar icon with a green check beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶要检验合格、在有效期内。

shots.scene: 减压阀接口刷上肥皂水检漏
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand brushes soapy water onto a regulator connection on a gas cylinder to check for leaks. No people.
shots.narration: 用专用减压阀，接好后检漏。

shots.scene: 老李用气瓶推车搬运气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer moves a gas cylinder with a two-wheeled cylinder cart, the cylinder strapped on.
shots.narration: 搬运用推车，不能在地上滚。

shots.scene: 满瓶和空瓶分开摆放，挂空白吊牌
shots.prompt_en: Full cylinders and empty cylinders stored in separate groups, each with a blank hanging tag. No people.
shots.narration: 空瓶满瓶分开放，远离热源。

shots.section_title: 遵守规程，大小事故都能减少
shots.scene: 一串小伤口图标和一个大警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A row of small bandage icons next to one large yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 多数事故不大，常因忘了规程。
overlay: 遵守规程，大小事故都能减少

shots.section_title: 遵守规程，大小事故都能减少
shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地举起空白规章
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank rulebook with a serious face.
shots.narration: 严重事故也真会发生，守规就能减少。

shots.section_title: 小事故、未遂事件也要报告
shots.scene: 小研填写空白报告单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in a blank incident report form at a desk.
shots.narration: 小磕碰、差点出事，也要报告。
overlay: 小事故、未遂事件也要报告

shots.section_title: 小事故、未遂事件也要报告
shots.scene: 老周和小研一起看报告单，指出原因
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews the blank report form with the female graduate student and points at one section.
shots.narration: 找出原因，下次就能避免。

shots.scene: 小研提醒阿杰戴好护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student taps the young male student's shoulder and points at his safety goggles; he puts them on.
shots.narration: 看到同事不安全，及时提醒。

shots.scene: 欣欣和大家站在一起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with the female graduate student, the young male student and the older man in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 好的科学，从安全开始。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现插头和插线板图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a plug and a power strip.
shots.narration: 液体远离电，先断电再维修。

shots.scene: 耐热手套和低温手套图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of heat-resistant gloves and long insulated cryogenic gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 高温低温，都戴对应的手套。

shots.scene: 畅通通道和小心地滑提示牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clear lab aisle and a yellow wet floor caution sign. No people.
shots.narration: 通道畅通，地上不放东西。

shots.scene: 被绑带固定、戴保护帽的气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a strapped gas cylinder with a protective cap. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶固定好，不用戴好帽。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the door of a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 处处留心，平安实验，下次见！
